text_block_list.text:
—"There's an Umamusume named Haru Urara 
who keeps trying her hardest, no matter 
how many times she loses."

Then came a day when whispers of such talk 
began echoing all around the racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, winning is so hard! Everyone just 
goes zoom, swoosh!"
choice_data_list: What do you think it'll take to win?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's see, hmm~...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I got it! I just have to enter the 
race alone!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"And then, since I'll be the only one 
there, 1st place is practically 
guaranteed~!"
choice_data_list: I'm not sure you can call that a race...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really? And here I thought it was an 
ingenious idea~

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, isn't that Haru Urara over there? 
Heyyy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Did someone call me?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
You've been working crazy hard lately! I'm 
rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text: Yo! If it isn't our gutsy Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! Everyone knows who I am?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby D
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We even joined your fan club, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Passerby E
text_block_list.text:
Never giving up even after losing is the 
best! Show us all how hard you can run~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Waaah~! Yeah, yep, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! I look just like an idol, right! I'm 
so glad I ran a bunch~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's really looking forward to 
seeing me run!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run in front of everyone so much 
more!

Haru Urara's motivation is climbing even 
higher. Focusing on gaining experience 
while building her fanbase was definitely 
the right call.
choice_data_list:
Let's keep this momentum going and enter 
more races!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

And someday, once Haru Urara finds a 
target race of her own, I'll make sure she 
takes first place! Deep in my heart, I 
made that vow!
